title: Fixed Rear Feed Stick and Wire Stand Glue Applicator
description: One newly authored complete static craft glue-applicator exterior. A broad stepped wedge housing narrows into a short blunt front nozzle and seats on a canted full hand grip. A separate fixed trigger leaves a true hand opening. A complete rear annular feed collar surrounds an opaque fixed rear stick. A continuous bent-wire front support bail joins both housing sides and a small flat front foot, while the grip heel supplies the rear ground contact. A blank side plate and seated pivot caps complete the whole appearance. Three opaque materials; one prop and zero scenes. No cartridge cradle, large hairdryer air barrel or rear fan grille is imported. No adhesive output, heater, mains cable, motion, operating parameters, hand-fit or safety claim.
